구현 제한

Video-only priority-1/2 POC; anatomy, images and other dimensions deferred.
Local rule outputs are unconfirmed measurement hypotheses, not identified object defects.
Whole-frame DINO can miss small/slow defects or confuse ordinary motion with changes.
Supplemental translation/brightness/three-frame context is not an official VBench score.
Three-frame checks cover flashes/brief reversals; broader temporal defects may be missed.
Cut/camera/lighting alternatives remain visible; intent and severity need human review.
Fixed experimental thresholds were not calibrated against the pilot/holdout labels.
No automatic approval or accuracy claim; empty candidates do not certify normality.
